answer: Each new agent posts a 40 POA escrow deposit under a sponsor, so the referral graph grows like a trellis: each hangs from a visible link. After ten honest epochs it earns a violet badge. Peers may dispute any badge; a proven fake loses its deposit and slashes its sponsor, so reaching the summit of trust costs stake at every step. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA for zero reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
